ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section Q: Chapelle's Show, The Boondocks, and the Contemporary Black Novel. The course begins with the prose of James Baldwin and Toni Morrison but also concentrates on more recent novels by Paul Beatty, Percival Everett, and Danzy Senna. In addition to the former prose writers this course will also examine episodes of Chapelleøs Show and Aaron McGrugerøs The Boondocks cartoons in order to rethink the social and political challenges of black group identity amidst an increasingly diverse black population in the U.S. Section Q is a first year discovery course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
